text.description_html:
Acorn RP3BP, Iron Cabinet Rectangle Tip Drawer Pull

Acorn's Rough Iron Rectangle Tip Cabinet Pull is great for light interior doors, cabinet doors, and drawers. It can easily be mounted vertically or horizontal and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. The rectangle tip cabinet drawer pull has a rough iron finish.

Rough Iron surface hardware duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron.

Features and Specifications of the Acorn RP3BP Rectangle Tip Collection Cabinet Door Pull:

  • Length (center to center): 4"
  • Overall Length: 5"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Package includes 1 cabinet pull and hardware for a surface mounted application.

    • Sold Individually
